sloka: विशालस्य सुतो राम हेमचन्द्रो महाबलः ।सुचन्द्र इति विख्यातो हेमचन्द्रात् अनंतरः ॥१-४७-१३॥
transliteration: viśālasya suto rāma hemacandro mahābalaḥ ।sucandra iti vikhyāto hemacandrāt anaṁtaraḥ ॥1-47-13॥

translations.english: O Rama mighty Hemachandra was Vishala's son. Hemachandra's successor was the celebrated Suchandra.
